text_en: Abraham took another wife, whose name was Keturah.
text_cn: 亚巴郎又续娶了一个妻子，名叫刻突辣。

text_en: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
text_cn: 刻突辣给他生了齐默郎、约刻商、默丹、米德杨、依市巴克和叔哈。

text_en: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
text_cn: 约刻商生了舍巴和德丹；德丹的子孙是阿叔陵人、肋突兴人和肋乌明人。

text_en: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
text_cn: 米德杨的子孙是厄法、厄斐尔、哈诺客、阿彼达和厄耳达阿：以上都是刻突辣的子孙。

text_en: Abraham gave all he had to Isaac.
text_cn: 亚巴郎将自己所有的财产都给了依撒格；

text_en: But to the sons of his concubines Abraham gave gifts, while he was still living, and he sent them away from his son Isaac, eastward to the east country.
text_cn: 至于妾所生的儿子，亚巴郎给了他们一些礼物，在自己活着时，就叫他们离开自己的儿子依撒格，打发他们向东去，住在东方。

text_en: This is the length of Abraham’s life, one hundred seventy-five years.
text_cn: 亚巴郎一生的岁月共是一百七十五岁。

text_en: Abraham breathed his last and died in a good old age, an old man and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
text_cn: 亚巴郎寿高年老，已享天年，遂断气而死，归到他亲族那里去了。

text_en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite, east of Mamre,
text_cn: 他的儿子依撒格和依市玛耳，将他葬在面对玛默勒，赫特人祚哈尔之子厄斐龙的田间玛革培拉山洞内。

text_en: the field that Abraham purchased from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried, with his wife Sarah.
text_cn: 这块田地是亚巴郎由赫特人那里买来的；亚巴郎和妻子撒辣都葬在那里。

text_en: After the death of Abraham God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac settled at Beer-lahai-roi.
text_cn: 亚巴郎死后，天主祝福了他的儿子依撒格。依撒格定居在拉海洛依井附近。

text_en: These are the descendants of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s slave-girl, bore to Abraham.
text_cn: 以下是撒辣的婢女，埃及人哈加尔给亚巴郎生的依市玛耳的后裔。

text_en: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, named in the order of their birth: Nebaioth, the firstborn of Ishmael; and Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
text_cn: 依市玛耳的子孙名单，依照出生的次第记载如下：依市玛耳的长子是乃巴约特，其次是刻达尔、阿德贝耳、米贝散、

text_en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
text_cn: 米市玛、杜玛、玛萨，

text_en: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
text_cn: 哈达得、特玛、耶突尔、纳菲士和刻德玛：

text_en: These are the sons of Ishmael and these are their names, by their villages and by their encampments, twelve princes according to their tribes.
text_cn: 以上都是依市玛耳的儿子，这些人的名字也是他们的村庄和营地的名字，又是十二家族的族长。

text_en: (This is the length of the life of Ishmael, one hundred thirty-seven years; he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people. )
text_cn: 依市玛耳一生的岁月是一百三十七岁；然后断气而死，归到他亲族那里去了。

text_en: They settled from Havilah to Shur, which is opposite Egypt in the direction of Assyria; he settled down alongside of all his people.
text_cn: 他的子孙住在从哈威拉直到埃及东面的叔尔，往亚述道上，对着自己的众兄弟支搭帐幕。

text_en: These are the descendants of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham was the father of Isaac,
text_cn: 以下是亚巴郎的儿子依撒格的历史：亚巴郎生依撒格。

text_en: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel the Aramean of Paddan-aram, sister of Laban the Aramean.
text_cn: 依撒格四十岁时娶了帕丹阿兰地阿兰人贝突耳的女儿，阿兰人拉班的妹妹黎贝加为妻。

text_en: Isaac prayed to the Lord for his wife, because she was barren; and the Lord granted his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
text_cn: 依撒格因为自己的妻子不生育，便为她恳求上主；上主俯允了他的祈求，他的妻子黎贝加遂怀了孕，

text_en: The children struggled together within her; and she said, “If it is to be this way, why do I live? ” So she went to inquire of the Lord .
text_cn: 双胎在她腹内互相冲突，于是她说：“若是这样，我可怎么办？”遂去求问上主。

text_en: And the Lord said to her, “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples born of you shall be divided; the one shall be stronger than the other, the elder shall serve the younger. ”
text_cn: 上主答复她说：“你一胎怀了两个国家，你腹中所生的要分为两个民族：一个民族强于另一民族，年长的要服事年幼的。”

text_en: When her time to give birth was at hand, there were twins in her womb.
text_cn: 到了生产的时候，她腹内果然是一对双生；

text_en: The first came out red, all his body like a hairy mantle; so they named him Esau.
text_cn: 首先产出的发红，浑身是毛，如披毛裘，给他起名厄撒乌。

text_en: Afterward his brother came out, with his hand gripping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
text_cn: 他的弟弟随后出生，一手握着厄撒乌的脚跟，为此给他起名叫雅各伯。他们诞生时，依撒格已是六十岁的人。

text_en: When the boys grew up, Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
text_cn: 两个孩童渐渐长大，厄撒乌成了个好打猎的人，喜居户外；雅各伯却为人恬静，深居幕内。

text_en: Isaac loved Esau, because he was fond of game; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
text_cn: 依撒格爱厄撒乌，因为他爱吃野味；黎贝加却爱雅各伯。

text_en: Once when Jacob was cooking a stew, Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.
text_cn: 有一天，雅各伯正煮好豆羹，厄撒乌由田间回来，饥饿疲乏，

text_en: Esau said to Jacob, “Let me eat some of that red stuff, for I am famished! ” (Therefore he was called Edom. )
text_cn: 便对雅各伯说：“请将这红红的东西给我点吃，因为我实在又饿又乏。”──因此他的名字又叫“厄东”。

text_en: Jacob said, “First sell me your birthright. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯回答说：“你要将你长子的名分先卖给我。”

text_en: Esau said, “I am about to die; of what use is a birthright to me? ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌说：“我快要死了，这长子的名分为我还有什么益处？”

text_en: Jacob said, “Swear to me first. ” So he swore to him, and sold his birthright to Jacob.
text_cn: 雅各伯接着说：“你得立刻对我起誓。”厄撒乌遂对他起了誓，将自己长子的名分卖给了雅各伯。

text_en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew, and he ate and drank, and rose and went his way. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
text_cn: 雅各伯遂将饼和扁豆羹给了厄撒乌；他吃了喝了，起身走了。──厄撒乌竟如此轻视了长子的名分。
